glosses: present passive imperfective participle of абсорби́ровать (absorbírovatʹ)

examples.text: Абсорбируемый шов и нережущая игла могут использоваться по выбору.

glosses: Capable of being absorbed or swallowed up.
A material that can be absorbed.

examples.text: There is general agreement that nonabsorbable materials are better than absorbables. The most popular materials are polypropylene mesh and PTFE produced as a patch.
